title: Chapter 789
text:
The Central Galaxy and the Shattered Star Ring were separated by a few Star Fields, with a large number of desolate universe belts in between. The distance was very far. Back then, even if EsGod's subordinates took a super high warp speed spaceship, it still took them a few years to cross this distance through hyperdrive. If it was a normal non-hyperdrive flight, the travel time would probably be measured in hundreds of millions of years.

The first stop of the fleet was the Interstar Field Stargate that the Red Empire had built in the Shattered Star Ring.

The Interstar Field Stargate could greatly shorten the travel time, and it was the only stable and fast way to cross Star Fields. Naturally formed wormholes were not included in this.

The longer the distance of the stargate, the more difficult it would be to accurately locate it. The Interstar Field Stargate was a technological threshold that even Star Cluster civilizations could not achieve. The Super Star Cluster Civilizations did have this technology, but the three Universal Civilizations had made a rule that no civilizations other than them were allowed to build Interstellar Field Stargates. Therefore, the Interstellar Field Stargates between Star Fields were all products of the three Universal Civilizations, controlled by them, and divided into civilian and military uses.

Han Xiao and the others were planning to use the Interstar Field Stargate, which was more convenient and faster. As the dynasty's high-level allies, they naturally had the authority.

"I've already informed the guards at the Interstar Field Station. Once you report your identity, they will let you through and help you activate the Interstar Field Stargate. When you arrive at the Constellation Corridor, there will be dynasty troops there to receive you," Zoe said.

Zoel said through the communicator.

The Central Galaxy was the collective name of the mother Star Fields of the three Universal Civilizations, forming the center of the universe. These three Star Fields were the Abyss of Stars under the Radiant Federation, the Bright Silver Arm under the Arcane Church, and the Constellation Corridor, the territory of the Red Empire.

The Red Empire's Interstar Field Station in the Shattered Star Ring was located in a Star Cluster at the edge of the Shattered Star Ring. From the Black Star Corps headquarters, using the various Star Cluster level stargates and hyperdrive, it would take more than half a month to arrive.

Han Xiao stayed in the fleet and communicated with Teny and the other dynasty elites along the way. With his identity and status, coupled with the fact that they were on the same ship every day, most of them had formed a preliminary friendship with Han Xiao.

Only Teny's attitude remained lukewarm. He was suspicious by nature, and it was his habit to be vigilant.

However, Han Xiao knew Teny's personality quite well. If he took the initiative to please him, it would only cause him to be even more vigilant. Furthermore, it was unlikely that a Beyond Grade A would lower himself to please a dynasty colonel. Therefore, Han Xiao showed a fair attitude and never talked to Teny alone.

Based on Teny's hobby, Han Xiao decided to wait for him. As a Mechanic, there was a high chance that Teny would take the initiative to ask for guidance. After all, he was a member of the dynasty, and spending time with him was the best opportunity to ask for guidance. Although he did not know why Teny was so wary, it did not seem like there was a need to give up on such an opportunity.

After setting off for about ten days, Han Xiao finally heard Teny knocking on his door.

…

"You want to learn my mechanical skills?"

In the room, Han Xiao got Philip to control the hovering housekeeping robot to deliver two cups of calming green plant drinks to the table. He then looked at Teny and his adjutant, Corbus, on the opposite side of the table.

Teny nodded slowly. He did not touch the drinks on the table and said, "It's not really learning. I just want to communicate with you."

Since he had a favor to ask of Han Xiao, he naturally would not show a cold face. He put away part of his vigilance and humbled himself with a sincere attitude.

To him, there was nothing embarrassing about this. No matter what achievements he had in the future, he was only a dynasty colonel for now. There was a huge gap between his status and Han Xiao's.

Han Xiaoxin was overjoyed, but he did not show it on his face. He tapped the table with his finger and asked, "I only know that you're a Mechanic, but I've never heard you say which branch you're leaning towards."

"Pure Mechanic, Armed Branch. I crossed the Grade A boundary two years ago and became a Calamity Grade," Teny said.

"Hmm, although I'm not from the Armed Branch, I can still impart some experience to you." Han Xiao smiled. As a Beyond Grade A, he was qualified to teach others.

"That's my request." Teny nodded.

Every Beyond Grade A Mechanic had something they were good at. Some had a unique style, and some had unique skills. With Teny's current level, it was very difficult for him to come into contact with a Beyond Grade A Mechanic. Now that there was someone like Black Star, he did not want to miss the opportunity to learn from him.

When he first learned that he was going to be modified, he already had this idea. After observing Han Xiao for a while, he decided to put it into action.

Han Xiao talked with him for a few hours, and Teny felt that he had benefited a lot.

"That's all for today." Han Xiao stopped talking, and a smile appeared on his face. He tapped his temple and said, "I just sent some theoretical information to your communicator. Some of it is my experience, and some of it is the technical theories I collected. Take a look."

Hearing this, Teny nodded and said, "Thank you."

"You're welcome." Han Xiao waved his hand, held back his laughter, and said casually, "Anyway, there's nothing much on the way. If you have anything you want to ask, you can come and find me."

"Okay." Teny forced a smile, and his attitude became better. After all, he had taken advantage of Han Xiao's kindness.

Han Xiao knew that he had to take the benefits in moderation, so he did not continue. Teny bowed and left the room. His footsteps were much lighter.

Looking at Teny's back being separated by the door, Han Xiao shook his head and smiled. He was quite satisfied. With this relationship, their relationship had room to continue improving. Their Affinity was about to reach 'Friendly'.

With my identity, it's much easier to make friends with high-ranking people. Han Xiao sighed.

If it were a player, there would be almost no way to make friends with Teny. However, his situation was different. The current Teny was not as accomplished as he was in his previous life. Han Xiao's status was higher than Teny's, and Teny was the dynasty's ally. Under many factors, even if Teny seemed to be wary, he still came to Han Xiao's door.

With Han Xiao's current status, it was much easier for him to gain character favorability compared to the players.

…

In the next ten days or so, Teny would come to ask for guidance every other day. The relationship between the two of them gradually became friends. As the saying went, the one who reached the top would be the teacher. This future marshal of the dynasty was interacting with Han Xiao as a student.

Of course, due to his identity, he could not really be Han Xiao's student. However, Beyond Grade As did not have the obligation to impart their experience. Han Xiao being so generous was a huge favor to him. Although Teny was suspicious, he was not someone who could not differentiate good from bad. He remembered this favor in his heart and naturally would not stay away from Han Xiao.

On the other hand, every time Teny came to ask for guidance, he would bring Corbus along. Han Xiao also had a certain understanding of this person. This adjutant was loyal to Teny, and Teny treated his subordinates really well. Thus, Corbus received quite a lot of benefits from following him.

Han Xiao felt that he might be able to do something with Corbus. Just like chasing a girl, bribing her best friend was a shortcut. Although he could not bribe Teny's loyal subordinate, with how Teny took care of Corbus, if he did Corbus a huge favor, Teny might have a better impression of him.

Half a month later, the fleet finally arrived at the dynasty's military stargate station in the Shattered Star Ring.

In the dark universe, a hexagonal stargate floated. Dense space energy flowed within the gate, forming a dark blue vortex. Around it were the dynasty's heavy universe fortresses with guards stationed there. Unlike the civilian stations, there were no spaceships entering or exiting the stargate. It was only supplied to the dynasty's troops.

As the fleet approached, this stargate continued to expand in their vision. As they got closer, the edges of this stargate seemed to extend to the end of their vision. It was extremely huge and spectacular.

"Alert! Alert! Psionic Annihilation Cannon locked on! "

The artificial intelligence of the main ship that Han Xiao was on sent out the alert. Everyone's expression did not change. They already knew that once they entered the range of the military stargate, they would be locked on by the guards.

"Stop moving forward. Report your identity." The artificial intelligence of the main ship received a message from the guards.

"Black Star." Han Xiao verified his identity.

After a while, they received a message confirming their identity. The guards removed the cannon lock and signaled for the fleet to move forward.

This time, the main ship received a communication request from the guards. After connecting, a person who seemed to be the commander appeared on the screen and spoke with a deep voice.

"Your Excellency Black Star, Ambassador Zoel has already instructed us to set up a route for you in advance. This stargate teleportation is direct mode. The teleportation location is Crimson Ring Constellation Star Zone 8, directly entering the dynasty's territory. There will be a team of guards sent by the mother planet to pick you up. They will open a special spiritual flight path for you and bring you to the second jump. Only then will you be able to pass through the Psionic Seal Ring around the mother planet and reach the dynasty's mother planet."

Han Xiao nodded.

Universal Civilizations all had powerful weapons. In order to prevent each other from going crazy one day and using Beyond Visual Range Primordial Psionic Energy to destroy their mother planet, the mother planets of all Universal Civilizations had all kinds of cutting-edge barriers and defense measures. It was as if they were wrapped in layers of filters. Only certain methods could be used to enter and exit. Normal flight was not possible at all.

Then, this commander looked at Teny on the side and pulled out a smile on his seemingly paralyzed face. "Teny, long time no see."

"It's you." Teny's expression was a little strange. "Why are you guarding the stargate here?"

"This is an order from the superiors." This commander shook his head. There was a hint of bitterness in his eyes, but he immediately suppressed it.

This commander and Teny were both graduates of the dynasty's' Journey 'Advanced Military Academy in the same period. They knew each other, and their results were also very outstanding. They should have had a bright future, but Teny did not expect him to be sent to guard a stargate.

Guarding a stargate was not a good job, especially a military stargate. There was not much chance to contribute, and they would have to take responsibility if something went wrong. However, for the safety of the stargate, they had to send out elite troops to guard it. Therefore, the officers guarding the stargate were either randomly sent over or unlucky people who were ostracized in the faction wars. No one would take the initiative to choose this position.

Hearing this, Teny knew that this friend of his had clearly suffered greatly in the faction wars. He shook his head helplessly and said, "Then, guard it well. You'll be transferred away in a few years anyway. Treat it as training your troops."

The rotation period of the troops guarding the stargate was not long. Usually, it would be changed once every six to ten years. The dynasty would not sit back and watch their elite troops be wasted at the stargate station.

After chatting for a while, this commander ended the communication. At this moment, the fleet was about to enter the stargate.

An extremely strong suction force came from the other side of the stargate, trying to pull them all in like a black hole.

The fleet entered the stargate, and the world outside the porthole lit up instantly.

The interior of the stargate was filled with violent space energy, but it was restrained by the stargate technology and built a stable path. It was like a beast had turned into a tamed pet.

The movement of the spaceship seemed to have stopped. No one could feel any sense of speed. It was as if the fleet had stopped moving in the stargate.

However, it seemed like only an instant had passed. The spaceship suddenly shook, and the space energy around it disappeared like a receding tide. The scene outside the porthole became a pitch-black universe dotted with gem-like starlight again.

The stargate that was originally at the front was now at the back of the fleet.

The distribution of the fortresses around it had also changed. The number of troops guarding this stargate station was more than ten times larger than before.

A special fleet was waiting in front of everyone. The appearance of the spaceship was different. It seemed to be a very unpopular spaceship model.

Beep beep …

At this moment, every quantum network receiving terminal received a regional broadcast from this special fleet.

"Welcome to the Central Galaxy, Your Excellency Black Star."
